Label: local donor ID
Definition: An identifier that uniquely denotes objects only within the scope of a specific object aggregate and that is not registered in an identifier registry. [Allotrope]

Label: repository
Definition: 'Repository' trailing modifier (qualifier, 'repository') of 'xref' links of 'Format' concepts. When 'true', the link is pointing to the public source-code repository where the given data format is developed or maintained. [EDAM]

Label: donor source
Definition: The origin of the donor/subject in this experiment.

Label: sex at birth
Definition: An organismal quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's ability to undergo sexual reproduction in order to differentiate the individuals or types involved. [PATO]

Label: age value (years)
Definition: A time quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of how long the bearer has existed. [PATO]

Label: birth country name
Definition: The name of the country where a subject was born. [NCIT]

Label: date of death
Definition: The year wherein the subject or donor has ceased to exist.

Label: hemisphere
Definition: One of two bilateral, largely symmetrical organ subdivisions within the telencephalon which contain the cerebral cortex and cerebral white matter. [UBERON]

Label: post mortem interval
Definition: The length of the temporal interval between the time of death of the subject/donor and the time at which the specimen is made.

Label: RIN
Definition: The RNA integrity number value of a specimen.

Label: RIN tissue source
Definition: The tissue sample location or identifier that is used for calculating the RNA integrity number.

Label: brain weight measurement
Definition: The weight of a brain specimen.

Label: photo 2d available
Definition: The status (available, unavailable) of two-dimensional photos of a subject/donor/specimen.

Label: scan 3d available
Definition: The status (available, unavailable) of three-dimensional scans of a subject/donor/specimen.

Label: antemortem MRI available
Definition: The status (available, unavailable) of antemortem MRI images of a subject/donor/specimen.
